BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. CPU
   C. Keyboard
   D. Monitor

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

3. When learning Building Construction Project Phase 11, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Construction Project Phase 11.

4. When learning Fixings and Fittings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fixings and Fittings.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fixings and Fittings.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fixings and Fittings.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Fixings and Fittings.

5. When learning Floor Finishes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Floor Finishes.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Floor Finishes.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Floor Finishes.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Floor Finishes.

6. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

7. When learning Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drawing.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Computer Aided Drawing.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Aided Drawing.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Aided Drawing.

8. When learning Waste Water Disposal, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Waste Water Disposal.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Waste Water Disposal.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Waste Water Disposal.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Waste Water Disposal.

9. When learning Pre-cast Concrete Products, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pre-cast Concrete Products.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre-cast Concrete Products.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Pre-cast Concrete Products.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre-cast Concrete Products.

10. When learning Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.

11. When learning Building Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Drawing.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Drawing.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Drawing.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Building Drawing.

12. When learning Wall Finishes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Wall Finishes.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Wall Finishes.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Wall Finishes.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wall Finishes.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Maintenance of Plumbing Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Electrical Services and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Building Construction Project Phase 11 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
